question: India's first Genetic Bank for Wildlife Conservation is located at:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hyderabad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India's first Genetic Bank for Wildlife Conservation is located in **Hyderabad**.
 
• It is established at the **Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology (CCMB)**.
 
• The genetic bank aims at **preserving the genetic material of endangered species** of animals, birds, and reptiles.
 
• This initiative is crucial for **biodiversity conservation and research** in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Genetic Bank**

 
 
• A genetic bank is a type of biorepository which preserves genetic material.
 
• In the context of wildlife, it involves the collection and storage of genetic material like DNA, RNA, and gametes (sperm and eggs).
 
• This genetic material can be used for research, breeding programs, and to revive species that are endangered or extinct.
 
 
 
• **Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology (CCMB)**
 
 
• Located in Hyderabad, CCMB is one of the premier research institutes in India.
 
• It operates under the aegis of the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR).
 
• CCMB focuses on high-quality basic research in the areas of modern biology.
 
 
 
• **Biodiversity Conservation**
 
 
• Biodiversity conservation refers to the protection, preservation, management, and restoration of natural habitats and their ecological communities.
 
• This includes efforts to protect species from extinction and to preserve genetic diversity within species.
 
• It is essential for maintaining ecosystem services, resilience, and overall environmental health.
 
 
 
• **Endangered Species**
 
 
• Endangered species are those that are at risk of extinction due to a sudden rapid decrease in their population or a loss of their habitat.
 
• Conservation efforts for endangered species include habitat preservation, legal protection, and breeding programs.
 
• The genetic bank plays a pivotal role in these conservation efforts by preserving the genetic diversity of these species.
